data.name: AEROC
data.description: AEROC (Aeroc GmbH) is a Cologne, Germany-based startup founded in 2024 by Felix Nosske and Georg Sticka that develops Enhanced Rock Weathering carbon-removal projects on agricultural fields. The company manages the full ERW value chain — sourcing and grinding basalt at local quarries, transporting it to farms, and handling MRV via measurement and modelling. As of 2025 the team includes a dedicated isotope geochemist and they have launched their first ERW project in Germany.
